source.label: 2025 Current Population Survey Annual Social and Economic Supplement

method.taxUnits: Census TAX_ID; reference-person MARSUPWT; joint schedule from FILESTAT 1-3
method.earnings: Tax-unit WSAL_VAL. Married units retain the highest adult wage as the primary earner and assign remaining unit wages to the secondary side; non-joint units use total tax-unit wages as primary.
method.children: All persons under 18; under-6 uses A_AGE < 6
method.adultCredits: All persons age 18+ assigned to the tax unit
method.runtime: Cells are frequency-compressed exact tax-unit states; no behavioral response is baked into the snapshot.
